trigger: First one-shot 42-stage verifier after schema 3.4 implementation, executed against the last published CP0008 subject
rootCauseSummary: quality-cancellation exposed a workflow scheduling race: cancellation could arrive while CHECK_DISPATCHED was persisted but before the sandbox activity handle existed, so the accepted cancellation failed to stop the subsequent 900-second check. quality-false-pass attack T also necessarily escaped because the immutable CP0008 subject predates the CP0009 reconstruction correction being verified.
notes: The complete verifier passed 40/42 stages. The run is preserved in full; no isolated stage rerun replaces it. The cancellation race is repaired and guarded, while attack T requires a new complete verifier over a published CP0009 implementation subject.
